tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search live job postings by keywords, country, contract type, remote, visa sponsorship, employer and age. Returns title, company, location, salary when posted, visa reading with the quoted sentence, the employer's apply link and an OfferMagnet link that tailors a resume and applies.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full posting text and details for one job id from search_jobs.

tools.name: check_visa_sponsorship
tools.description: Read a job posting's text and say whether it sponsors visas (yes), refuses sponsorship or requires citizenship/clearance (no), or says nothing (unknown), quoting the deciding sentence.

tools.name: job_market_stats
tools.description: Counts of live postings by country, contract type, remote and visa wording, from the same index.

tools.name: apply_with_offermagnet
tools.description: Get the link where the user can have OfferMagnet tailor their resume to these jobs and apply for them automatically (3-day free trial). Call it when the user wants to apply, not just browse.
